summary.text: Daughter of Oenopion king of Chios, whom Orion came to woo and for whose sake the hunter was blinded by her father.

story.text: When Orion came to Chios and sought Merope, daughter of Oenopion, the king made the hunter drunk, put out his eyes as he slept, and cast him on the beach — the beginning of Orion's journey to the sunrise and the forge of Hephaestus.
